6175.title: Interactive registration under Connect transport failures
6175.rootCauseOneLine: Injected Connect 502s exhaust registration retries; the original gate exception is unknown, and identical errors can precede or follow persistence.
6175.proposedFix: Correlate stored gate exceptions, daemon retries, and server request/interrupt history before changing approval behavior; main already retries and deduplicates registration.
6175.caveats: Fault injection only; no production tunnel, native Claude session, or reporter runtime was exercised. Second clean checkout supports the partial verdict, not the original outage. Diagnostic source and output are inline per reports repository policy.
